div.p: At SmartphoneKey, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website and services.

Cookies: Small data files stored on your device to enhance your browsing experience and provide personalized content.

div.p: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

To Improve Our Website: To analyze user behavior and improve the functionality and content of our website.

div.p: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your information with:
